definitions.explanation: An art exhibition featuring the work of a single artist. Short for {個人|こじん}{展覧会|てんらんかい}.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}、{初|はじ}めての{個展|こてん}を{開|ひら}く。
examples.english: Next month, I'm holding my first solo exhibition.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}の{個展|こてん}を{見|み}に{画廊|がろう}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to a gallery to see a friend's solo exhibition.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{国内外|こくないがい}で{個展|こてん}を{開|ひら}いている{人気|にんき}の{写真家|しゃしんか}だ。
examples.english: She is a popular photographer who holds solo exhibitions both domestically and abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
{個展|こてん} is the standard word for a solo art exhibition. It is an abbreviation of {個人|こじん}{展覧会|てんらんかい} (individual exhibition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個展|こてん}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a solo exhibition)
- {個展|こてん}を{開催|かいさい}する (to organize a solo exhibition)
- {初|はつ}{個展|こてん} (first solo exhibition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{展覧会|てんらんかい} is the general term for "exhibition." グループ{展|てん} is a group exhibition. {回顧展|かいこてん} is a retrospective exhibition.
